tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ tsakra saṃ bha ra/ ma ha mā yā/ he badzra/ gu he sa ma ya dza/ badzra be ra/ ḍā ki ni mahā ka la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /khyung po rnal 'byor bdag gis gus btud nas/ /phyi rabs rgyud 'dzin rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rnam thar zur tsam bshad kyis gus pas nyon/ /ban chung bdag gi skye sa gangs dkar mda'/ /snye mo ra mang rje'u rigs khyung po ste/ /pha rus smos pa khyung rgyal stag skyes dang / /ma rus smos pa mgos gza' bkra shis skyid/ /de gnyis rum du bdag nyid zhugs pa'i tshe/ /pha ma yul mi bde skyid ldan par gyur/ /stag gi lo la ma'i rum nas brtsams/ /de tshe rgya gar grub thob a mo ghas/ /'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste rgya gar bgrod/ /paṇḍi ta dang grub thob thams cad kyis/ /thugs bcud bsdus nas 'gro rnams smin grol byed/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul bar 'gyur/ /theg chen snying po mtha' bral chos sgra sgrog /mthar thug gsang sngags bde stong dbyer med kyi/ /seng ge'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrog par byed/ /de yi lus ni bde mchog 'khor lo ste/ /gsung ni ma hā mā yā'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /thugs ni dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje te/ /sprul pa'i gnas mchog gsang ba 'dus pa la/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gshin rje gshed du 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor de dag lus la bkod nas ni/ /gdul bya rnams la dngos grub ston par byed/ /gzhan yang yi dam sna tshogs gzugs bsgyur nas/ /gdul dka'i skye bo dpag med 'dul bar byed/ /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcu 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de'i mthar ni mdzad pa btul ba'i tshe/ /ltas dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston par 'gyur/ /de nas zhing khams rnam dag bde ba can/ /rgyal ba kun bsngags zhing der sangs rgyas nas/ /theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ /phyi rabs dad ldan skyes bu thams cad kun/

/rgyal ba'i zhing der 'gro bar the tshom med/ /de skad gsung nas bla ma grub thob de/ /mkha' la bya bzhin rgya gar yul du gshegs/ /lo lnga lon nas pha mas lung bstan bshad/ /lo bcu lon tshe yig rtsis mkhas par shes/ /bcu gnyis lon la pha mes bag chags kyis/ /sems phyogs bon bslabs rdzogs chen phyag chen bslabs/ /de nas rin chen gser phye phangs med khyer/ /gces pa'i srog la ma ltas dka' spyad nas/ /rgya dang bal po'i yul du lan bdun phyin/ /rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ /khyad par mkhas shing grub thob lnga bcu dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyad 'phags rnam bzhi bsten/ /longs sku drug pa rdo rjer 'chang chen la/ /dngos su chos gsan ye shes mkha' 'gro gnyis/ /mnyes par byas nas mthar thug man ngag zhus/ /sgro 'dogs chod nas rtse gcig bsgrubs pa yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /rnam thar mdor bstan yin gyi gus pas zungs/ /de la bdag gi skye sa snye mo ra mangs/ rus khyung po/ pha stag skyes/ ma bkra shis skyid do/ /de yang dang po bdag btsas ma thag grub thob a mo gha byon nas dbang bskur blo 'phel gyi cho ga mdzad nas gong bzhin lung bstan nas/ bla ma nyid rgya gar du gshegs so/ /de nas lo lnga lon nas pha mas lung bstan bshad/ lo bcu lon pa dang klog dang yi ge dang rgya rtsis dang dus 'khor mkhas par shes/ dang po nas pha mes bon po'i dge bshes yin pas/ de'i zhen pa'am bag chags kyis lo ngo bcu gsum la slob dpon g.yung drung rgyal po la bon phyi nang thams cad bslabs pas mkhas par shes nas/ bka' sa li bgram sa bdun brgya tsam byung nas sgrub thabs dang bstan bcos bka' 'grel mang po brtsams te/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bon gyi bstan pa dar bar byas pas/ bon la mkhas shing grub thob du gyur/ slob ma yang mkhas pa mang du thon/ khyad par du'ang rong po dge ba rgyal gyis khams su bon dar bar byas te/

rta dang dngul bre brgya la sogs pa brgya phrag bcu gsum phul nas bon gyi zab don thams cad dbang po rab 'bring gsum du 'dril ba gcig zhu zer ba la/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum dang gnad bdun gyi mgur blangs pas/ rong pos sna drangs pa'i slob ma lnga bcu rtsa lngas lta sgom gyi don khong du chud/ lha tshogs mang po'i zhal mthong nas/ nus pa phyogs med du thon pas/ bdag rtsod med du gyur kyang / bdag la the tshom cung zhig skyes te/ bon 'di rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta dang / lo tstsha ba rtsod med thams cad kyis kyang bsgyur ba mi 'dug mi thams cad kyis kyang khyod chos par mi 'dug bon por 'dug zer bas/ grub thob a mo ghas lung bstan pa bzhin du/ rgya gar du 'gro dgos snyam nas gser mang po grabs byas pa dang / pha ma gnyis na re/ nged gnyis rgas pas ma shi bar du rgya gar du ma 'gro zer nas ma btang nas/ bon gyi grwa pa rnams dbu che mkhas pa la gtad nas nyan bshad dang / bsgrub pa la btsud do/ /de nas bla ma 'byung gnas seng ge la rta dang dar zab dang gser mang po phul nas rdzogs chen klong sde/ sems sde/ man ngag gi sde rnams bslabs pas/ khyad par du sems mdo bco brgyad la grwa pa sum brgya tsam byung nas mkhas par grags so/ /de ltar phyogs bzhi'i grwa 'du bsdom ba'i dus su bdag gis bsams pas/ rdzogs chen 'di lta ba mtho bar 'dug ste/ spyod pa theg tshugs pa zhig las mi 'dug pas/ da lta sgom spyod gsum 'dzom pa'i chos shig btsal dgos snyam nas/ grwa pa de rnams bzhag nas/ lha sa bstod lu dang sho ma rar/ bskor ni ru pa'i spyan sngar phyin nas phyag rgya chen po'i rtsa rgyud rab tu mi gnas pa/ bshad rgyud bsam mi khyab pa/ gsang ba gnyis su med pa/ rnyog pa med pa/ mtshan brjod ma hā mā yā rnams zhus/ sgra nag gi brgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed rgyud sgrub thabs bcas pa ste/ bskor ba'i chos rnams ma lus par zhus/

'bul ba dang / nan chags dang / nyams len gyis bla ma shin tu mnyes par byas shing mnyes nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga la da lta yungs dkar zho gcig gi grwa pa yod kyang / nga yi chos rnams ma lus par rdzogs pa khyung po rnal 'byor pa khyod las med do yang yang gsungs so/ /de ltar chos rnams mkhas par brlabs nas chos la mos par byung yang / thun mong gi dngos grub kyi rtags sam ltas gcig la cung zad ma mos nas/ da lta bod na grub thob 'di las che ba mi 'dug bla ma 'dis kyang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad rang ci thob mi shes par 'dug pas/ da ci nas kyang rgya gar du 'gro dgos dgongs nas yul du phyin te/ sru mo bza' mi gnyis la bu med par longs spyod chen po yod nas gser g.yu skyis pas/ rgad po na re/ khyod mi ngan yin/ dang po bon dang rdzogs chen gyi grwa pa zhabs tog can de rnams skyur nas/ da 'khor dang longs spyod gnyis ka med pa zhig byung 'dug khyod la gser g.yu nam yong zer nas ma btang ba la/ sru mo na re/ khyod la skyin pa mi 'dod cig g.yu zho bcu gcig yod pa 'di 'bul/ nged bza' mi gnyis la rgas khar phan thogs pa'i chos gcig rgya gar nas skyol zhig zer ro/ /de nas zhing btsongs pa dang sngar gyi grwa pas gser g.yu phul ba rnams la srang bcu byung / g.yu de las stod du btsongs pas/ gser mang po khugs pa rnams khyer nas/ bal po ru phyin pas/ paṇḍi ta bha su na ma ti dang mjal nas gser srang gsum phul te/ bid pa ta bslabs/ gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi dbang zhus nas/ kri ya dpung bzang dang / rig pa mchog dang / legs pa grub pa dang / don yod zhags pa la sogs pa kri ya'i brgyud sgrub thabs lnga bcu zhus/ de nas yang paṇḍi ta a thu la badzra dang mjal nas/ khong gi zhal nas yang na ngas bal por chos bslab cig yang na rdo rje gdan na sangs rgyas gnyis par lung bstan pa'i bla ma rdo rje gdan pa can du dengs ngas bskyal zhig gsungs pa la/

da ci nas kyang rdo rje gdan du 'gro dgos snyam ste/ kho bo khyung po rnal 'byor gyis/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod par/ 'jigs skrag chen po gting nas skyes/ /'khor ba mtha' med 'di 'dra ba/ /skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /'chi bas mi 'jigs skye bas 'jigs/ /skye ba las kyi rjes su 'brang / /rang dbang med par 'khor bar 'khyam/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyang / /cis kyang mi phan 'chi ngo shes/ /nam kyang 'chi bar 'dra ba la/ /chos phyir srog kyang btang snyam nas/ /lus dang srog la ma bltas te/ /bal yul tsam la ma ltos par/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 'byung gnas pa/ /ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /rdo rje gdan du tshangs kyi phyin/ /rgyal ba thub pa chen po yis/ /sangs rgyas gnyis par lung bstan pa'i/ /dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pa dang / /dngos su zhal mjal dkon pa yi/ /gu lang gser srang lnga bcu phul/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal snyam nas/ /ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrugs/ /mos gus chen po gting nas skyes/ /gus pas thal sbyar 'di skad zhus/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge slong gi /mkhan po mdzad nas 'dul ba zhu/ /byang chub chen por sems bskyed nas/ /theg pa chen po'i chos rnams zhu/ /smin byed gsang sngags dbang bskur nas/ /grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs zhu/ /de skad bdag gis gsol btab pas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pa yis/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan 'di skad gsung / /srin po gdong dmar mtha' 'khob yul/ /log ltas rgyud 'khrugs the tshom can/ /sna tshogs chos tshol sgrub mi nus/ /rang ma smin par gzhan la bshad/ /gcig la gcig smra phrag dog can/ /mi nag chos kyi lo rgyus mkhan/ /de lta bu'i rgyal khams nas/ /dad ldan skye shis 'jigs pa yi/ /snying stobs ldan pa'i skyes bu khyod/ /ma nor dam chos tshol ba'i phyir/ /bal yul tsam la ma ltos par/

/srog la mi phangs dka' spyad nas/ /rgya gar yul rnams bgrod byed pa'i/ /skal ldan khyung po rnal 'byor khyod/ /sngon tshe byang phyogs gangs can du/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul dpag med ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po zhes byar gyur/ /de tshe log ldan mu stegs dang / /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po dang / /skye bo'i tshogs rnams 'dul bar byed/ /khyod ni nyan thos tshogs bskor nas/ /mkha' la bya bzhin rnam par rgyu/ /ri dang chu la thogs med cing / /gcig dang du mar snang la sogs/ /sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs 'chang pa'i/ /dgra bcom chen po nyid gyur pas/ /bdag dang rgya gar mkhas rnams kyis/ /khyod kyi mkhan po byed mi nus/ /byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs na/ /glang ri 'od ldan gser can na/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /sprul pa bzhugs kyis der song la/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po zhus/ /yul dbus ma ga rdo rje'i gdan/ /gnas mchog 'di dang gzhan rnams su/ /khyod kyi ji skad zhus pa yis/ 'dul ba phar phyin gsang sngags rnams/ /ji skad 'dod bzhin bstan par bya/ /de nas bdag gi dge tshul gyi/ /mkhan po zhus nas/ ming tshul khrims mgon du btags pas/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i shangs khrag shor nas/ khyung po rnal 'byor las spo ma nus so/ /de'i dus su bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyung po dzwa ki ma ha pha la gsung nas/ thog mar 'dul ba lung dang / bstan bcos mdor rtsa gsungs so/ /de nas rjes shrī bha dra ya dzñā de ri ma la ya la bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin te/ sems bskyed zhus nas/ byams pa'i chos lnga dang rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa sde lnga dang / tshad ma sde bdun zhus so/ /yang bai ro tsa na ra kri ta lho phyogs ko sa la'i dur khrod nas rdol na/ rtsa'i spyil po nang 'khor paṇḍi ta bcu tsam la chos gsungs pa dang mjal nas de gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / he badzra bcu gsum dang / 'khor lo sdom pa lha bcu gsum dang /

mahā mā yā lha lnga dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang / lha lnga'i go nas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs so/ /yang bai ro tsa na ra kri ta dze ta'i tshal na bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dbang dang bcas pa zhus so/ /yang rdo rje gdan pa chen po la rdo rje gdan du rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po gcig tu dbang zhus so/ /de ni rin po che rgya mtsho'i rtsar rgyud bshad rgyud dang / dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi bre'i nang na ji ltar zhugs bzhin no/ /de la rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dbang dang / rgyud dang / bsgrub pa'i thabs gdams pa mchog gi khyad par ni/ bde mchog gi grol rgyud las/ rgyu lam 'bras bu bstan pa yang / /bde ba chen po 'grub pas na/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje ni/ /bde ba bsgrub pa nyid yin ste/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa dang / /snying po dgyes pa rdo rje dang / /dga' chen za nus sgyu 'phrul che/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa dang / /drag po rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / /mthar thug ston pa lnga po la/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi rgyud/ /zung du 'jug pa nyid yin pas/ /dang po rmi lam dbang la yang / /phyi nang gsang ba nyid yin no/ /lam la rim pa gnyis yin te/ /bskyed rim dang ni rdzogs rim mo/ /bskyed pa snang dang rdzogs pa stong / /dbyer med zung 'jug chu zla bzhin/ /rdzogs pa rang lus gzhan lus dang / /zung 'jug bde stong dbyer med do/ /'bras bu mchog dang thun mong ngo / /thun mong las brgyad grub chen brgyad/ /mchog la sku bzhi mdzad par bcas/ /lhun grub gang 'dul rang shar ro/ /gang zag sbyangs pa'i las can gyis/ /rtse cig ma yengs 'bad gyur na/ /dam tshig ldan pas nges par thob/ /rang lus thabs ldan lam dang ni/ /gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dod yon lam khyer gnad mchog gi /brgyud pa mchog gi rim pa yang / /sangs rgyas lung bstan thob pa yi/

/slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / /'od gsal bstan pas grub pa brnyes/ /rkam pa la zhes bya ba dang / /phyag rgya khyi ru sprul byed pa'i/ /ku ku ri pa chen po dang / /nya lto gsol zhing grub pa thob/ /lo hi pa zhes grags pa dang / /lhag pa'i lha yis byin brlabs pa/ /dpal 'dzin he ri ke la dang / /de dag rnams las rim brgyud pa/ /ḍoṃ bhi ba dang ku su lu/ /mahā badzra legs bsdus ste/ /dpal ldan ye shes te zhes pa/ /bai ro tsa na ra kri ta/ /su ma ti zhes nā ro pa/ /ta thā ga ta ra kri ta/ /a mo gha ni badzra dang / /dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pa rnams/ /rim gyis bdag la brgyud pa'o/ /yang dpal la li ta badzra/ pad ma zhabs/ en ṭa bāo ti chung pa/ dpal 'dzin/ a mo gha badzra/ bai ro tsa na ra kri ta nas brgyud pa'i/ sgra nag dang 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa dang / sgrub thabs rdo rje 'od dang / rtog pa gsum pa dang / gsang ba mthar thug gi gdams pa rnams zhus so/ /rje rdo rje gdan pa la/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / sgrol ma'i rgyud gdams ngag dang bcas pa dang / mtshan brjod dbang rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / gsang sngags kyi rjes su yi rang dang / sgrub pa'i lam rim dang / rtsod pa'i lam rim dang / gzhan yang bya rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / spyod pa'i dang / rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sgrub thabs zhal gdams dang bcas pa rnams zhus/ kha che dgon pa ba dang / rdo rje gdan pa la/ rdo rje sa 'og dang / 'byung po 'dul byed dang / gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud dang / gnod sbyin shing rta'i rgyud dang / rnam sras zhi ba dang drag po rnams zhus so/ /de nas bla ma chen po ri ma la ya'i rtse na bzhugs pa la gser srang bcu gsum phul nas/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa byas pa'i tho rangs kyi tshe na/ nam mkha' las me tog char bzhin babs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bar snang khengs/ /sgra dang 'od dang 'ja' tshon 'khrugs/

/lha rnams mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje gdan pa 'di skad gsung / /rigs kyi bu khyod bod du song / /gdul dka' kha ba can ljongs kyi/ /sems can mang po grol byed cing / /phyi ma'i tshe na chos 'di rnams/ /khyod kyi rgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /gcig gis dar bar byed par 'gyur/ /chos 'di rnams kyi bka' thob cing / /phan sems ldan pa de yi ni/ /gang byung rgyal sras ma nor ston/ /rab tu mi gnas la sbyor ste/ /rim gyis don rtogs mang du byung / /grub mtha' gzhung chen bzhi nyid las/ /mtshan nyid theg dang rdo rje theg /khyad par rnam par 'byed pa yi/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu lam byed pa/ /mngon gsum rjes dpag rim pa yis/ /gtan tshigs chen po bzhi la ni/ /mtshan nyid gsum gyi gtan la 'bebs/ /de ni rtsod pa'i lam rim mo/ /pha rol phyin dang gsang ba sngags/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /thun mong lam lnga khyad par gnyis/ /zhal spyod don bsdus lam byed pa/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag lam rim gnyis pa'o/ /de nyid mthong lam zhes bya'o/ /lta ba ngan pas ma gos pa'i/ /ye shes mngon du byed pa'i lam/ /mtha' dang bral ba'i don nyid ni/ /zung du 'jug par ston pa dag /dbu ma chen po nyid du gsungs/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong ting 'dzin ni/ /gong nas gong du lam sbyong ba/ /sems kyi lam sbyor zhes byar bstan/ /nga dang 'dra bar khyod kyi rtogs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan bdag gis thos/ /khyod kyang 'di nas sangs rgyas zhing / /bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rtsod ldan gdul dka'i sems can la/ /skyo ba ma skyes phan sems sbyong / /bde mchog dkyil 'khor rang byon gyi/ /sa ru gdul bya khri phrag 'byung / /zhes lung bstan mdzad do/ /de nas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du/ rgyal ba mai tri pa'i slob ma zhing gi rdo rje/ mi mnyam rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje/ rdo rje mched gsum gyis gshin rje gshed bsgrubs nas/

las sbyor byed pa dang mjal te/ gser srang re re phul nas gshin rje gshed kyi dbang zhus/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud sgrub thabs dang ra sgrol zhus nas/ zla ba bdun de nyid du bsgrubs pas/ dang po gshin rje gshed dmar po'i zhal mthong / de nas nag po'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal mthong ngo / /de nas de wi ko ṭir ḍā ki ma ka na ka shrī la/ saṃ bu ṭa'i rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / rdzogs rim de kho na nyid yang dag bsdus pa dang / dpal mchog drwa ba sdom pa rgya mtsho dang / ye shes rgya mtsho dang / ye shes mngon 'byung dang / dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyud rnams zhus so/ /de las bram ze ratna pha la la gshin rje gshed zhus pas/ khyod la g.yu 'bul ba'i sru mo bza' mi gnyis la med tshol dang / lte sgyur 'di skyol bu gsum 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan nas/ bod du 'ongs pas dpal mo dpal thang la dgra byung nas/ ra sgrol gyi las sbyor byas pas/ zan gyi ras 'gro shes pa byung / de la gsad sngags rgyab pas ra khrag bskyugs nas shi ba dang / jag pa thams cad khrag bskyugs nas shi'o/ /yang lan gcig jag pa byung ba la/ sdigs mdzub bstan pas rengs pa dang 'gyel ba dang / khrag bskyugs pas mthu dang nus pa'i grags pa chen po byung ngo / /de nas yul du sru mo bza' mi la med tshol dang lte sgyur bslabs pa'i tho rang lha mo dkar mo gcig byon nas/ khyod kyi med tshol 'dis bu gsum 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bu che ba la shangs pa mgon/ 'bring po la shangs pa dar/ chung pa la shangs chung du thogs shig khyod bla ma shangs par grags pa'i dus su bu spun gsum po 'dis rtsa ba'i yon bdag du gyur te/ lo re la nas stong tsho gsum gsum dang gser g.yu rta khrab la sogs pa'i zhabs tog byed par 'gyur ro gsungs nas/ khong gi steng khang gi logs la bu spun gsum gyi ming bris pas/ bu gsum byung nas bdag gi rtsa ba'i yon bdag tu gyur to/

/de nas sngar gyi slob mas kyang longs spyod chen po phul ba rnams gser du sgyur/ gu lang gi gser kha rdol ba dang phrad nas/ gser mang po byung nas/ mang yul skyid rong du slob mas bskyal nas dbang zhus gser mang du phul lo/ /de nas bal po pham mthing pa la bde mchog dang gdan bzhi zhus nas rgya gar du phyin te/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la gser srang brgya phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nā ro pa'i slob ma dha chen po la chos zhus shig gsungs nas lung bstan te/ bla ma dha chen po shrī na lend+ra na bzhugs pa la/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags bskor rnams dang / dgyes rdor rnams dang / gdams ngag mang du zhus so/ /yang su ma ti bhi ti chen mo la/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang nag po'i chos drug la sogs pa bde mchog mang du zhus/ shar ljon shing ku sha'i tshal du dpal ra ma pha la la phyag rgya chen po gsang ba grub pa zhus/ rje na te ghan dha ba/ shar bhi tra ma pu ri la bzhugs pa la ye shes grub pa dang dbang rin chen 'khor lo dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud dang / ye shes dgongs pa bla na med pa la sogs pa rgyud gdams ngag mang du zhus so/ /rje btsun ma rin chen lha mo ki ka ta'i grong khyer na bzhugs pa la/ phyag rgya chen po snying po'i bskor rnams zhus/ ku ku ri pa'i slob ma grub thob nyi ma'i snying po dzña la dha ra'i dur khrod na bzhugs pa la/ phyag rgya chen po rab tu mi gnas pa/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun dang / rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs mang du zhus/ bla ma mai tri pa lho phyogs 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs pa la/ phyag rgya chen po rab tu mi gnas pa la sogs pa'i rgyud lnga dang / mdo ha dang / phyag rgya chen po dag pa ye shes dang / sku gsum lam khyer la sogs pa'i gdam chung mang du zhus/ yang dgyes rdor dang mtshan brjod la sogs pa'i rgyud sgrub thabs mang du zhus/

yang mai tri pa ko sa la bhi kṣa'i dur khrod na bzhugs pa la gser srang bdun phul nas/ bod longs spyod chung pas nor sgrub myur la rtags mtshan che ba cig zhu byas pas/ mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ yid bzhin gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ tsan dan gyi mgon po zhes kyang / thugs rje chen po nag po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya/ dang por bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ dgra thams cad rlag par byed pa/ zlog pa dang nang dmes mi tshugs pa/ mchog thun mong thams cad lo zlas 'grub pa/ mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhor la 'byung ba/ thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhor la 'byung ba zhig yod kyis de sbyin gsungs so/ /de su la zhus byas pas/ sngon gyis dus na sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi spyan sngar thugs bskyed chen pos sems bskyed de/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du bdag sangs rgyas par ma gyur cig gal te sems bskyed de nyams par gyur na/ mgo bo tshal pa stong du 'gas par gyur cig ces brjod nas dam bcas te/ ri bo po ta lar nyin mtshan drug du sems can rnams la ye shes kyis gzigs pa 'jug cing / gang la gang 'dul gyis don byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lo dpag tu med pa'i bar du sems can gyi don mdzad pas/ sems can mang po thar grol byung las che snyam nas po ta la nas gzigs pas/ sems can gyi khams la 'phel 'grib med pa'i steng du snyigs mar song bas/ nyon mongs rags la/ 'dug pa cher song 'dug pas/ da ni bdag gis sems can 'ga' tsam yang grol bar byed mi nus par 'dug snyam nas sems bskyed btang ba dang / dbu tshal pa stong du gas par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byon nas/

rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i sems bskyed las gzhol ba shin tu ma legs pas/ de'i bshags pa la sems bskyed de bas rgya che ba gcig skyor zhig gsungs nas/ dbu tshal pa stong du gas pa de dbu bcu gcig tu byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas sngar gyi sems bskyed de bas rgya che ba med cing / de'i cha tsam gcig kyang ma nus pas/ de bas rgya che ba'i thabs ni gang yang med do snyam nas zhag bdun gyi bar du brgyal bar gyur to/ /de nas brgyal ba de sangs pa dang / da ni snyigs ma'i sems can tshe thung la bar chad mang ba rkyen dbang 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba/ longs spyod chung zhing 'tsho ba dman pa/ sgrub long med par bar chad kyi dbang du 'gro ba/ dam tshig mi bsrung pas log pa dang nang dme byed pa chos byed phal cher yang bar do'i 'jigs pa las mi thar bar gzigs nas/ yun ring bsgrub mi dgos par zhal mthong ba/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'di phyi'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ mi nor zas gsum shugs las 'byung ba/ bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig gis rlag par byed pa/ mchog thun mong thams cad lo zla tsam gyis 'byung ba'i dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i khro bor gyur nas sems can gyi don bya'o snyam ste/ thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag gcig thon pa las ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur gyur pa dang / sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag tu med pas mgrin gcig du bsdebs te/ rigs kyi bu sems can gyi re ba tshul bzhin du bskangs pa'i spyod pa 'di lta bu ni shin tu legs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed po 'di nyid kyis 'phrin las kyi nus mthu dang ldan par bya'o/ /gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dbang gi rang bzhin gyis dbang dang ldan par bya'o/

/de nyid kyi zhi ba dang rgyas par yang 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las su dbang bskur ba'i sprul pa las byung ba'i gnod sbyin dang / gshin rjes dang / srin po dang / bdud dang / ma mo rnams kyis kyang las sna tshogs bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /de nyid tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa dang / mchod pa dang / dran pas kyang dngos sgrub ma lus pa thams cad ster bar 'gyur ro/ /ma bsgrub pa nyid nas byin gyis brlab pa dang / de nyid kyis dngos su zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ /ces gsung so/ /de nas dpal sha ba ri pa zhes bya ba/ bram ze'i rigs su gyur pa/ dpal 'bras spungs dang nye ba na grong khyer chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i dbus na/ tri pa la zhes bya ba rol mo mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur nas/ sngon sangs rgyas la klu dang rol mos mnyes par byas pa des/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi 'jag ma'i spyil po gcig na sgrub pa mdzad kyin bzhugs rtsa na/ nam mkha' la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra chen po sgrogs nas gzigs pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po 'di byon nas/ rigs kyi bu nga'i sgrub thabs zung zhig gsung nas/ sha ba ri pas bsgrub thabs yi ger bkod/ yang rje btsun ma dang / thugs rje chen po dang / sgrol ma gsum yang byon nas bsgrub pa'i thabs gsung ste yi ger ma (la)bkod do/ /ngas ni lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud dang / gdams ngag rnams zhu dus su phyag drug 'di gnang nas zhag nyi shu rtsa cig na zhal mthong ngo / /khyod kyang phyag drug pa 'di la nas rjen thags kyi gtor ma dang / spos sbyar ma chad par gyis/ khyi nag po la rdo ma rdeg yid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ de ltar byas pas ri la sogs pa'i bsgrub gnas thams cad du 'tsho ba sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ /zhag bcu gsum gyi slob ma dang bcas pa la zhal dngos su ston par byed do/

/dngos grub thams cad kyang tshul bzhin du ster bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan nas bka' sgo lan gsum du mdzad do/ /de nas gser srang lnga brgya khyer nas/ rgya gar shar nub/ lho byang la sogs pa phyogs kun tu rgyu zhing grub thob kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dang dngos su mjal ba su yod ces dris pas/ paṇa tri dang grub thob rnams mthun par/ na ro paṇa tra ta'i lcam mo/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma zhes bya ba dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po la dngos su chos zhus pa gcig yod zer nas/ de gnas ga na bzhugs byas pas/ snang ba dag na gar yang zhal mthong la/ ma dag na btsal bas mi rnyed de dag pa'i sa la gnas pa dang / 'ja' lus su gyur pa'i phyi ra ro/ /'on kyang dur khrod chen po sa'i gling gi seng ldeng gi nags gseb tu ḍa ki ma'i tshogs 'khor gyi dpon la res 'ga' byon no zer nas/ ḍa ki ma'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mchil ma 'khrugs pa dang / ba spu g.yo ba'i mos gus skyes nas/ dur khrod so so'i gling gi seng ldeng gi nags gseb na phar la na mo bhuddha ya'i gsol ba 'debs kyin phyin pa dang / shing rta la bdun srid tsam gyi nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog smug nag tu yod pa rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa phyag na kha ṭwāṃ ka dang thod pa bsnams pa gcig gcig dang du ma la sogs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs su bstan zhing gar sgyur ba mthong nas/ 'di ḍa ki ma ni gu ma yin par 'dug snyam nas phyag 'tshal/ bskor ba du ma byas nas/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa zhu 'tshal byas pas/ nga ni sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma yin/ nga yi 'khor rnams byung nas za 'ongs pas da lta myur bar bros shig gsungs so/ /de nas phyag dang bskor ba byas nas gsang sngags kyi gdams pa zhu 'tshal byas pas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi chos zhu ba la gser dgos pa yin/ gser yod na bya yis gsungs nas/ gser srang lnga brgya phul ba dang nags gseb tu gtor ro/

/der 'di nges par sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma rang yin nam/ gser la ni phangs pa mi 'dug snyam pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i spyan nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pas/ 'khor ḍa ki ma dpag tu med pa nam mkha' las byung nas/ 'ga' zhig gis gzhal yas khang gsum rim pa skad cig la bzhengs/ kha cig gis rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ 'ga' zhig gis tshogs kyi yo byad sog cing tshes bco lnga'i nam srod la sgyu lus rmi lam gyi dbang bskur mdzad nas/ dbang thob pa dang bod kyi ban chung yar 'deng dang gsung nas dpag tshad gsum ḍa ki ma'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas/ yud tsam gyis bsgrod pa dang / gser gyi ri mi che tsam gcig gi steng gi nam mkha' la ḍa ki'i tshogs kyis bskor nas gar bsgyur zhing 'dug go /ri de'i phyogs bzhi na gser gyi chu rgyun bzhi 'bab cing 'dug nas/ gser gyi ri 'di lta bu rgya gar na yod dam/ mkha' 'gro mas sprul ba lags zhus pas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bskyur byed pa'i/ /chags sdang rtog pa sna tshogs 'di/ /rang bzhin med par rtogs tsam na/ /thams cad gser gling yin no bu/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur goms byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /mos gus stobs las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /da nga yis byin gyis brlab cig rmi lam zungs shig gsung nas/ rmi lam bzung pas zin nas/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi gnas su phyin pas/ lha ma yin shin tu che ba gcig gis/ khyung po rnal 'byor pa ngas mid zer nas nga khyur gyis mid pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma nam mkha' la byon te/ bu gnyid ma sad par gyis shig gsung nas/ dus de nyid du chos drug gi khrid tshar bar mdzad de/ gnyid thun gcig la chos drug tshar ba rgya gar na'ang khyod las med do gsungs/ de nas dngos su khrid tshar gsum dang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang / sgyu ma lam rim gsungs/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang dang sgrub thabs dang gdams pa rnams gsungs/

dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang / mtshon cha can bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ brtag gnyis dang gur gsungs/ sam bhu ṭa sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / mtshon cha can gyi bskyed rim rgyas bsdus gsum dang / de kho na nyid bzhi'i gdams ngag gsungs/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis dang / bcu gsum dang lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ mtshon cha can dang dus 'khor gyi gdams ngag de kho na nyid bzhi'i zhal gdams gsungs/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i grib sel gsungs/ bde mchog rim lnga'i rdzogs rim dang / thig le'i rdzogs rim rnams gsungs so/ /rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i las tshogs thams cad gtan la phab nas gsungs/ mdor na ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma de nyid kyis/ rgyud sgrub thabs gdams pa dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa gsungs so/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ chos drug gi dbang gdams pa dang bcas pa 'di/ rje btsun zla ba na dang / nga gnyis ma gtogs pa rgya gar na yang shes pa med pas/ mi rabs bdun du chig brgyud las ma spel zhig de rnams kyang rim pas byin gyis brlab cing lung bstan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gser srang brgya phul nas/ bde mchog lha lnga dang mkha' spyod dkar dmar dang / rim lnga gdan thog cig ma dang / sbyor drug la sogs pa'i gdams ngag mang du zhus so/ /de nas yang gser srang lnga brgya khyer nas rgya gar nub phyogs su phyin te/ sangs rgyas dngos su mjal ba'i bla ma su yod ces dris pas/ paṇḍi ta rol pa'i rdo rje dang / ārya de wa dang / ḍa ki ma su ma ti la sogs pa grub thob bcu gsum gyi zhal nas/ nged rnams kyis dbang bskur la gdams ngag bstan nas/ de'i rjes la lung ston par 'gyur ro gsungs nas/ gser srang brgya phul nas dbang dang gdams pa ma lus pa zhus so/ /khong rnams kyi zhal nas/ nged gsum po 'di'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/

khyad par du paṇḍi ta ārya de wa la bdag med ma'i nang khrid bstan pas zla ba bdun na sa brgyad kyi rtog pa la 'khod pa'i/ ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma su ka ma si ti zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang dang / bdag med ma la dngos su chos gsan pa zhig yod kyi/ des khyod la byin gyis rlob par byed cing gdams pa bstan par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas ārya de wa la nang khrid zhus nas/ ḍa ki ma de'i yul gang na yod rigs ci yin da lta ga na bzhugs ces dris pa dang / rigs kyis bu legs par nyon la zungs shig dang bstan par bya'o/ /de la kha che khri stan na/ grong khyer chen po 'bum tsho sum cu so gnyis yod pa'i nub byang gi grong khyer gcig na/ bza' mi bdun yod pa la/ rgyags la 'bras bum chung gang las med pa dang / dus der mu ge chen po byung nas/ bu khyo rnams na re/ rgan mos 'bras bum pa gang po 'di tshags gyis shig sang ni jo bo nam zla ring po byung rtsa na bza' dgos so/ /nged rnams kyis zas tshol du 'gro yis zer nas/ bu khyo dang bu mo rnams phyogs thams cad du phyin pas/ thams cad du mu ge chen po byung ba thug nas bza' ye ma rnyed do/ /de'i dus su dge slong sngon po gcig byung nas/ rgan mo jo bo nam zla ring po ka nga yin 'bras bum pa gang po nga la drongs shig zer ba dang / rgan mos 'bras la la dge slong la drangs/ la la mo rang gis zos pa dang / bu khyo rnams kyi bza' ma rnyed par 'ongs pa dang / khang par dus cig la slebs nas/ a ma 'bras bum pa gang po kha phye la byin zhig phyogs gang du phyin yang zas ma rnyed pas bkres pas nyen par gyur to zhes zer ba dang / mas smras pa/ jo bo nam zla ring po chos gos rnams gsum dang / lhung bzed bsil byed dang bcas nas byung bas/ de la mos nas 'bras byin pas med do byas pas/ khong rnams na re rgan mo 'dis med pa tshol ba mi 'ong ste/

yod pa rnams kyang brlags par byas nas mi 'ong bar 'dug pas/ 'di ma bton na skyid mi 'dug pas thon zhig zer nas/ bu khyos rgan mo khang pa nas ston to/ /de nas rgan mo des gar phyin na drag byas kyin mi rnams la dris pa dang / mi rnams na re/ nub phyogs u rgyan na pho skyes thams cad dpa' bo/ mo skyes thams cad dpa' mo/ rig pa rang bzhin gyis dwangs pa/ 'tsho ba rtsol med du 'byung ba skyid pa zhig yod zer nas/ u rgyan du phyin pa dang / 'bras rtsa ba dang thug nas 'bras blangs pas khal rnyed do/ /de blangs nas bhe ta'i grong khyer du phyin nas chang 'tshong ma byas pas 'bras mang po byung ngo / /de'i dus su u rgyan gyi phug tu rje birwa pa gsang spyod mdzad kyin bzhugs nas/ rnal 'byor ma gcig gis chang dang sha nyos nas dam rdzas byed pa la dus re shig tshe na/ rgan mo chang 'tshong ma de la chang nyos pa dang / rgan mos smras pa/ rnal 'byor ma rtag tu chang nyos nas su la 'khyer byas pa dang / rnal 'byor mas smras pa/ nags khrod ya gi na bla ma bzang po gcig yod pas de la 'dren pa yin byas pas rgan mo na re/ tshogs ma bsags pas dbul zhing 'phongs par gyur/ rgas nas bu khyos bton pas longs spyod la snying po mi 'dug pas/ chang rin mi 'dod zer nas/ 'bras chang nying sring byas kyin dus rgyun du bskur ro/ /de nas rje btsun birwa pa'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor ma chang rin mi dgos par chang 'di lta bu gang nas byung gsungs pa la/ de snga dang mi 'dra ba'i rgan mo dad pa can gcig 'dug nga bla ma bzang po gcig la 'dren pa yin byas pas/ chang rin mi 'dod zer nas chang rtag tu bskur ba yin zhes smras pas/ birwa pa'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor ma rgan mo de khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren dgos khrid la shog gsungs nas/ rgan mo de la de skad byas pa dang / 'o na shin tu dga' zer nas 'bras chang nying sring byas pa bum pa do dang /

phag gi sha gcig khur nas birwa pa la phul ba dang / de'i nub mo rje btsun ma'i gsang bsgrub kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur ba dang / dus de nyid du ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar gyur to/ /de la bu khyos bton dus lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu nyo tshang lo gcig byas pas drug cu tham pa/ birwa pa dang mjal dus drug cu rtsa gcig pa de/ dbang bskur bas lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod lta bu lang tsho dar la bab pa sku mdog dkar ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la bzhud pa/ bdag med ma dang dbyer med pa'i ḍa ki ma su ka si ti zhes bya bar gyur nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po la dngos su chos gsan pa gcig yod do/ /ḍa ki ma de snang ba dag na gar yang bzhugs la zhal yang mthong ngo / /snang ba ma dag na btsal bas mi rnyed do/ /res 'ga' ni bde ba sbyin pa'i gnas tsan dan gyi nags tshal zhes bya bar tshes bcu'i dus su/ ḍa ki ma rnams kyi tshogs dpon mdzad cing brda'i sgo nas chos ston pa'am/ yang na gsung gis chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /der song la gsol ba thob cig dbang bzhi bskur nas gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mtha' dag ston par 'gyur ro gsungs nas lung bstan mdzad do/ /de nas gser srang lnga brgya po de khyer nas bde ba sbyin pa'i nags gseb na yar na mo buddha ya'i gsol ba 'debs kyin phyin pas/ tsan dan gyi nags de'i steng gi nam mkha' la ḍa ki ma sku mdog dkar la dbu skra sil bus sku rgyab mnan pa/ phyag gnyis skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ḍa ki ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de mthong ba dang lus ba spu ldang zhing mig mchi ma 'khrug pa/ sa dang po lta bu'i dga' ba skyes nas/ zag med kyi bde ba'i nyams dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas me tog utpal dang / padma dang / ku mu da la sogs pa mang po gtor nas phyag dang bskor ba brgya stong du ma byas te yang dag pa'i gdams ngag zhu 'tshal byas pas/

ḍa ki ma'i zhal nas/ birwa pa dang bdag med ma/ rdo rje 'chang dngos su thob/ gsang sngags mngon sum lam pa yin/ /smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi dang / /grol byed bskyed rdzogs 'dod pa la/ /dkon pa'i rin chen phye ma phul/ /gus pas thal sbyar brkyang phyag 'tshol/ /dman pa'i zhabs mthil gtsug gis longs/ /dus 'dir bdag gis grol bar bya/ /de ring rnyed pa mchog rnyed do/ /rigs kyi bu dag e ma ho/ /rigs kyi bu dag e ma ho/ /rigs kyi bu dag e ma ho/ /ces lan gsum gsungs pa dang / gser srang lnga brgya phul lo/ /de nas yang ḍa ki ma'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi slob ma yang slob dang / /phyi rabs brgyud 'dzin thams cad la/ /nga yis dngos su byin gyis brlab/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro/ /zhes gsungs nas dang po sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ de nas gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur nas/ gsang sgrub lte ba sprul 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs/ dbang bzhi nyams len gyi gnad dang bcas pa thams cad gsungs so/ /de la ye shes/ ḍa ki ma su ka ma si ti 'di dang por drin ches te/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur/ bar du drin che ste/ lha'i bu mo dang dbyer med du bsam yu mdzad/ tha mar drin che ste/ gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas/ bdag nyid bde ba can du bcu bzhi'i sa thob par lung bstan/ slob ma yang slob brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa thams cad la/ thugs rjes bzung nas/ dag pa bde stong gi mkha' spyod du 'gro bar lung bstan no/ /de nas bdag gi brgyud 'dzin thams cad kyang kun las khyad par 'phags pas na/ bsags pa yang rabs 'ba' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma su ma ti ma ha dang / mkha' 'gro ma gaṅgā dha ra/ kun tu bzang mo rnams gser srang bdun dang / mos gus kyis mnyes par byas/ ma rgyud kyi rdzogs rim gyi gdams pa/

dbab bzung / bzlog 'grem/ rlung dang bsre ba/ ye shes chen po la skyel ba'i gdams pa mang du zhus so/ /yang rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs 'od ma'i tshal du/ paṇḍi ta bde ba'i rdo rje la gshin rje gshed dang / sgra nag dang 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa dang / gsum pa dang / khro bo rnam rgyal gyi rgyud dang / lha mo rnams zhal dang / bya rog rkang gnyis dang / thod pa brtags thabs dang / mi g.yo ba'i rgyud sgrub thabs mang du zhus so/ /yang paṇḍi ta rol pa'i rdo rje la gser srang brgya phul nas/ lha mo dang mgon po'i sgrub thabs brgya bcu dang / phyi rol pa dang / nang pa'i phyir bzlog dang / nyi khros kyi rgyud la sogs pa'i ser ba dang / thog dbab bsrung ba dang / sman spyad sde skor bdun pa la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du zhus so/ /de nas bla ma a ta ya badzra la rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhus nas/ rnam 'joms kyi rgyud dang / lha bcu gsum dang / lha bcu gcig dang / lha lnga dang / lha gcig ma'i sgrub thabs zhus nas/ de nyid kyi bum pa dang / rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la bzhugs pa dang / bram ze'i thod pa mtshan ldan rnams gnang ngo / /bdag la yang rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nus par lung bstan no/ /de nas gzhung dang / gdams pa'i spros pa chod nas/ da bod du phyin la bla ma rnams la gser gyi chos skyel zhig bya dgos snyam nas/ rdo rje gdan du mchod pa phul/ tshogs mchod cig byas nas/ gsol ba btab pa'i tho rangs la/ bla ma a ni la ta badzra dang / ḍa ki ma su ma ti dang / rje btsun ma sgrol ma byon nas/ phyi rol dbang phyug chen po dang / /bde mchog khar sa pa ni rnams/ /rang byon gzugs su yod pa yi/ /gnas su gdul bya 'dren par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bal por slebs pa dang / paṇa chung dang / rgyal po dang / bha ro rnams kyis dbang dang rgyud zhus/

mang yul dang / spu rangs bstod du sngar gyi slob mas spyan drangs nas bsod nams byung / bdag bsam pa bzang pas/ 'dzam bu bo dang / gu lang la sogs pa'i gser kha bcu gsum rdol ba dang dus mtshungs nas/ dbang bskur dang sems bskyed thengs re re la gser srang brgya phrag mang po byung / la stod lho byang dang tshong dus dang nang khong rgyud gsum dang / gnye mo'i bar du gdan 'dren rnams kyi sar phyin pas/ gser gyi glegs bam dang / rta dang gser g.yu dang / dar zab la sogs pa'i longs spyod dpag tu med pa byung nas/ da rgya gar du 'gro dgos snyam pas/ gser srang lnga brgya phrag drug dang / bla ba lnga brgya khyer nas rdo rje gdan du phyin te/ rgyal po la mchod pa bya bar zhus pas gnang nas/ gser srang brgya bcu la zhag bcu'i bar du rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod chen po byas pas/ me tog gi char chen po nam mkha' las babs pa dang / 'od dang sgra dang / ḍa ki ma gar sgyur ba dang / lha'i bu dang bu mos mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar gyi ltas sna tshogs byung pas/ rgyal po dang bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i paṇḍi ta dang khyab bdag thams cad kyi dzwa ki chen pos/ mahā bho ti'i pu tsa mahā pha la pha la/ zhes brjod cing mnyes par gyur to/ /de nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang / ye shes kyi ḍa ki ni gu ma dang / su ka ma si ti dang / rdo rje mched gsum la sogs pa'i bla ma brgya lnga bcu la/ gser mang po phul tshogs kyi pu tsa mang po byas pas/ bla ma 'ga' zhig gis gnad kyi gdams pa mang du gnang / 'ga' zhig gis thugs las 'khrungs pa'i gdams ngag mang du gnang / 'ga' zhig gis lung bstan mang po mdzad do/ /bla ma mai tri pa mi bzhugs kyang jo mo ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma gaṅgā dha ra la gser mang po phul nas gdams pa mang du zhus so/ /de nas bod du 'ong khar tshes bcu la rdo rje gdan du mchod pa phul tshogs brgya rtsa byas nas/

lo tstsha ba glan dar ma blo gros dang / gha ya dha ra dang 'grogs nas mtho lding gi gtsug lag khang du 'ongs pa dang / rgya dpe 'ga' yi yi ge rul 'dug nas/ slar yang rgya gar du log la 'gro dgos snyam tsa na/ paṇḍi ta ti paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na bzhugs pa dang dus mtshungs nas/ khong gi zhal nas nga'i rgya dpe dang gcig par 'dug rin chen bzang po bsgyur du bcug pas chog gsungs te/ lo tstsha ba rin chen bzang po dang / glan dar ma blo gros gnyis kyis bsgyur ro/ /de nas jo bo ti paṃ ka ra la sems bskyed dang / gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhus/ sgra nag 'jigs byed dang / mngon rtogs brgyan dang / rgyud bla ma dang / gzhan yang gdams pa mang du zhus nas/ yul du 'ongs pas/ sgo mo'i jo btsun khyung po dang / dngul btsun sprang po gnyis kyis chos 'khor btsugs nas/ chos thon pa dang khong gnyis na re lha sar 'deng gsungs nas gser gdugs gcig yod pa khyer nas phyin te/ tshes bcu gsum gyi dgong mo gser gdungs phub nas mar me btang mchod pa bshams nas/ nged gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ nang par rmi lam bshad par byas pa dang / nga la jo bo'i zhal nas tho rangs kha 'di skad gsungs/ khyod ni sngon byung byang phyogs kyi nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po yin/ sngon gyi las 'phro sad pa yis/ /bka' ba spyad de rgya gar bsgrod/ /da lta chos nyid mngon du gyur/ /gangs can gdul bya smin byas nas/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas khong gnyis la dris pas khyung po na re/ nga'i rmi lam na gzhu gnye gnyis kyi la kha na rnga gcig rdung ba rmis pas/ gzhu gnye gnyis ka nga'i mdun du 'dus pa gcig rmis zer tsa na/ de ka bzhin du byung ste/ gnas brtan gong thog la grags pa gcig byung ngo / /dngul btsun na re/ nga nas phung gcig gi steng na 'dug pas mi thams cad nga la nas len kyin 'dug zer bas/ skye ba gong thog la phyug pa gcig byung ngo /

/de nas glang ri thang pa chen po la bsnyen rdzogs byas nas/ 'phan yul 'jog po'i ri la sgrub pa byas pa'i dus su rgyags ye ma bzung ste/ bla ma mai tri pa'i zhal nas/ sgrub pa byed dus su mgon pos rgyags skyel du 'ong zhig gsungs pas/ rgyags skyel du 'ong du re tsa na ma byung par mgon po'i rgyun gtor chad nas/ dgong mo brag phug gi mdor phyin nas/ kṣe ta pa la/ dzi na mi tra/ tra ki ra tsa/ trag shad ma/ nga la rgyags nams kyang med de/ mgon po la yang rgyun gtor chad nas mi 'dug go byas nas 'o dod chen po bos pas nangs par 'bras khud tshong dus nas khams pa'i 'bul skyel tshan gcig byung nas/ dngul bre dang / rta dang / za 'og dang / dar 'bog dang / ja sig dang / sha mar thud gsum la sogs pa'i zas nor tshan po che phul nas/ zla ba phyed kyi bar du sems bskyed dang dbang bskur mang po zhus pas/ grwa pa ma shong bar/ 'jog po'i chad ka'i mdar dgon pa btab pas slob ma nyis stong tsam 'dus so/ /de'i dus su zla smad la mtshams byas/ zla stod la gro mtshams byas nas gzhung dang gdams pa mang du bshad do/ /yang lan pa spyil bur bsgoms tsa na/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa 'dus nas/ khyod kyi dgon pa shangs na yod kyis der gdul bya skyongs shig gsungs so/ /de nas shangs su 'gro dgos bsam tsa na tho rangs gcig kha ba chen po gcig byung pa'i nam langs ma thag la a tsa ra gcig mjal zer yin 'dug zer ba la/ nga mtshams la yod mi 'phrad byas pas/ rgya gar thag ring nas 'ongs pas na ba yin phrad dgos zer bas phrad de/ sman pa la bstan pas/ khrag tu 'dug zer nas/ gtar kha byed par byas pa dang / rnal 'byor pa'i gtar kha des mi 'ong gsungs nas nam mkha' la dkyil dkrung bzhugs te/ sku lus la khrag mang po bton nas nam mkha' la chags so/ /yang sa la bzhugs nas rlung langs gsungs nas sku mnye byed dgos byas nas rtsi mar byugs pas/

rnal 'byor pa'i sku mnye des mi 'ong gsungs nas/ yang 'u ru ru 'dug pa 'dug pa dang / nam mkha' la bzhugs nas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas kun dha mang po bton nas nam mkha' la chags pa dang / de rnams ba spu'i bu gar sib bsdus te sku mnye mdzad de/ nam mkha' la ḍa ki mang pos bskor nas gar sna tshogs bsgyur/ de nas grub thob cig 'dug nas phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas/ gser gyi maṇḍal phul nas thugs rjes gzigs par zhu 'tshal byas pa dang / ghu na a ka ra dang ni/ /ratna sa a ka ra zhes dang / /a bhu dzu ta la dang ni/ /bhu ta a ka ra na ste/ /bod du gshegs dang rnal 'byor pa/ /cig la dgongs pa che bo gsung / /'ongs pas khyod dang phrad pa yin/ /nga rgya gar nyi ma shar ma thag 'ongs pas/ bod pa rong dog pas nam langs ma thag slebs pa yin gsungs nas/ bla ma'i yul gang na yod rigs gang yin/ mtshan ci yin zhes dris pas/ lho phyogs e na bhe sha'i yul/ bhi ri dzñi zhes grong khyer de/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sa gzhi der/ yab ni u na ya dha ba/ ma ni pu tsa ni mi las/ /bdag kyang rgyal rigs thon gyur te/ /la sogs pa'i rnam thar zhib par gsungs so/ /de nas 'phan yul 'chad khar zla ba bcu gcig bzhugs te/ thog mar rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu dbang bskur/ de'i rjes la rgyud sde lnga sgos sgo dbang bzhi rdzogs re dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang re yang bskur nas/ de rnams kyi sgrub thabs re yang gnang ngo / /de nas rgyud brtag gnyis dang / sam bhu ṭi dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / ra li dang / dgyes rdor sgrub thabs mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / de nyid bzhi dang / phyag rgya bzhi ldan dang / rdzogs rim lnga ldan dang / bde mchog lu hi pa dang / dpa' bo gcig pa dang / rje btsun ma brgyud pa gsum ma dang / ma hā mā yā dang / ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun dang / de nyid kyi 'grel lugs chen mo dang /

shānti pa'i de nyid lnga lnga dang / 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bdun pa dang / sgra nag gsang ba sbas pa rnams zhus/ rdzogs rim la/ 'khor lo lnga'i rdzogs rim dang / rlung shing rta can dang / bum pa can dang / 'khor lo bcing grol/ 'pho ba ye shes dkar khung ma/ rdzogs rim ma/ rdzogs rim de nyid gsum pa zhus/ bde mchog gi rim bzhi dang / rim lnga dang / gsang 'dus kyi rim lnga gdan thog cig ma dang / rlung sems gnyis med zhus/ phyag rgya chen po do ha dang / dag pa ye shes la sogs pa'i ngo sprod mang du zhus/ dbu ma bden gnyis dang / de nyid bsdus pa dang / ngan song sbyong rgyud la sogs pa yo ga mang du zhus/ phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud 'byung po 'dul byed dang / dza li ma'i sgrub thabs gsum dang / mi g.yo ba'i rgyud sgrub thabs chen mo dang / rnam 'joms dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs dang / mgon po phyag drug pa'i 'khor bzhi'i sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / nyi khros kyi ser ba la sogs pa ser ba brgya rtsa brgyad gnang nas bstan pa bsrung dgos yin gsung ngo / /yang nyin gcig bla ma'i zhal nas/ dpon g.yog gnyis pos nyin gcig la mchod rten gcig tshar ba rab gnas zin pa byed dgos gsung nas/ bla mas sprul pa skyes ba dang / ḍa ki mang pos rogs byas pas/ mchod rten dang rab gnas gro gong du zin nas/ rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la bzhag go /de nas nga bal por skyol/ de'i bar du khyod slob dpon du gyis/ ngas slob ma'i tshul bya yis gsungs nas/ rong du zhang bde ba dpal la rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ 'dam du slob ma lnga bcu la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ gnam du thang pa jo bo rje la dbang bskur/ de nas shangs dang / 'jad rta nag dang / las bstod lho byang dang / mang yul rnams su gsang 'dus dang / 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur mang yul du slob ma bcu gsum la rnal 'byor gyis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/

de nas bal yul du tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bod na rdo rje'i sa gzhi med pas sgyu ma byar mi btub/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa sgrub du mi btub pas/ khyod nga'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la zhon la rgya gar du 'deng / tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa sgrub/ gdams pa lhag ma rnams kyang byin zhig gsungs pa la/ ga re shul na ma gcig yod/ rgya gar du bslabs pa'i chos 'di rnams kyis kyang bod la phan mi thogs par 'dug snyam pa gcig byung ba dang / bla ma'i zhal nas do nub rdo rje gdan du tshogs 'khor gyi dpon la 'gro dgos pa yod/ rtog pa'i bum bu khyod mi 'gro bar 'dug gsungs nas nam mkha' la bya bzhin du gshegs so/ /de nas bla ma la gsol ba btab cing ngus pas tshur byon te/ nam mkha' la bzhugs nas bdud rtsi tshig drug ma 'di gsungs so/ /sdug bsngal rtsa bar gyur pa/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa yin gyi/ /zhen 'dod phyogs ris med par/ /mnyam nyid don la zhog cig /tshe 'di mi rtag 'gyur zhing / /phyi mar mi 'chad skye bas/ /las 'bras tshul bzhin sgoms la/ /dam tshig gtso bor spyod cig /bstan pa ma thob bar du/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng bas gnod pas/ /ri dwags sman ma bzhin du/ cig pur nyams su longs shig /snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can/ /zhe sdang phrag dog che bas/ /yon tan ci skyes thams cad/ /bum nang mar me bzhin du/ /rtag tu sba bar gyis shig /gnas lugs zung 'jug yin gyis/ /cir snang sgyu mar bsgoms shig /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus 'di/ /nam yal nges pa med pas/ /rtag tu dran pas zungs shig /tshe 'dir dgos 'dod 'byung zhing / /phyi mar lam sna 'dren pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas lta bur/ /rtag tu dran par gyis shig /gsungs nas rgya gar du bzhud do/ /de nas mnye mo ra mang du sprul pa'i dmag gis g.yul ngo bzlog pas/ yul mi thams cad dad nas chos 'khor btsugs so/

/de nas 'phan yul 'chad kha dgon par bla ma ra hu la'i chos bskor rnams zhu ba'i grwa pa mang po 'dus nas/ lo gsum du chos bshad pa dang / seng ge gdong can la sogs pa'i ḍa ki mang po byon te/ shangs na dgon pa yod pas der gshegs tshal zer nas/ dpon g.yog sum stong gis shangs su phyin te/ zhong zhong gnas kyis snang drangs pa'i gnas dgon brgya rtsa brgyad lo gsum la btab nas/ de rnams kyi spyi dpon khyung pos byas te/ bdag gis chos nyan bshad dang / sgom bsgrub 'ba' zhig gtso bor byas pas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa pa khri tsho gsum 'dus pa'i dus su bdag la nad cig gis btab nas/ dpon slob bcu gsum gyis zhag bcu gcig tu mgon po'i gtor chen byas nas/ gtor ma bskyal tsa na/ thams cad kyis sku mdog dkar po gcig tu zhal mthong nas bdag gi nad drag go /de nas bzung nas mgon po 'khor bcas thams cad dang / rnam sras rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa bran bzhin du nyan zhing 'phrin las thams cad sgrub par byed do/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rangs dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang / mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum gyi zhal mthong nas de nyid bzhi'i gdams pa rnams gsungs/ de'i tshes bco lnga la 'jam dpal byon nas rin po che'i sgrom bu gcig kha phye nas/ dmigs pa'i sgrom bu gsungs pas/ sngar gyi rgya gar du zhus pa bas gnad zab pa mang po byung bas/ nad gdon thams cad dmigs pa de nyid btab pa tsam gyis sel ba byung ngo / /yang ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gsum la sgrol ma lha bcu gsum dang / rnam 'joms khro bcus bskor ba gcig zhal mthong nas/ dbang bskur byas/ bum pa dang / rdo rje dril bu nam mkha' la 'jog nus pa byung ngo / /de nas skye bo byang chub rgyal gyis 'bul ba lan gsum byas nas dbang bskur lan gsum du zhu ba phul du nas/ nga yengs nas brjed pas nyin gcig skyo sangs la phyin tsa na/

khos yang 'bul ba byas nas de ring nga la dbang bskur mdzad dgos zer ba la/ 'di kar bya yis byas nas spang gshongs de nyid du sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas/ kho'i nad gdon thams cad dngos su thon nas byung ngo / /de nas grwa pa mang po'i dus su khri tsho lnga 'dus pas thams cad thab kha 'ba' zhig la yengs nas/ nyan bshad dang bsgom sgrub tsam ma byung bas skyo ba skyes nas/ rgya gar du 'gro dgos snyam tsa na/ sgrol ma byon nas theg chung la ma zhugs par go cha chen po gon zhig gsungs pas/ bum chung gcig du gab nas zhag bdun ting nge 'dzin zas su zos pa dang / btsun chung gzim g.yog pa gcig mal sar byung gin ngu yin 'dug pas snying rje bar byung nas btsun chung ci la ngu byas pas/ mkhan po gar btsal yang ma rnyed pas ngus pa yin zer ro/ /de nas sos ka me tog rgyas pa'i dus su/ nyin grwa pa thams cad khrid nas spang khar phyin nas/ mi re'i mdun du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i bu mo lta bas chog mi shes pa mig zur mig lta ba 'dzum zhing sgeg pa snyan pa'i glu len pa mang po bstan pas thams cad dga' bar gyur to/ /yang sang yang ltad mo 'deng ngo byas pas grwa pa ma lus pa thams cad byung ba dang / yang mi re'i mdun du gshin rjes mi sha rlon pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ kha gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi sdug pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ sod cig rgyob cig zer ba lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs brdar ba sha stag thogs pa mang pos bskor 'dug pa dang / der tshogs pa thams cad dngangs skrag rengs brgyal bar gyur to/ de nas brgyal bsang ba dang / khong rnams na re 'di lta bu'i bar do'i las kyi gshin rje yin nam snyam nas brgyal ba lags pas/ bla mas lha mo gshin rje rnams sprul pa yin nam/ 'di lta bu'i snang ba 'byung ba ci yin zer ba la/ chags sdang yul rnams thams cad kun/ /rang gi sems las byung ba ste/

/rnal 'byor pa yi snang ba la/ /sha za la sogs srin po'i gzugs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs lag na thogs/ /tshe srog dus 'dir bdud byed kyang / /sgyu mar shes pas grol bar 'gyur/ /lha mo mdzes ma rgyan gyis brgyan/ /glu len snyan pa'i sgra sgrog cing / /yid 'ong mang pos mtha' bskor yang / /rang snang sgyu mar thag chod na/ /de dag gis kyang 'ching mi nus/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i chos dang bar do'i chos ston pas/ thams cad nyan bshad dang sgom sgrub la brtson par gyur ro/ /de nas nyi ma gcig dge bshes rong po dkon mchog rgyal gyis brag ring gyi mtha' 'og du mang skol byas nas/ rta brgya dang dngul bre bcu gcig phul/ dar zab mang po yang phul nas/ khyung po rnal 'byor khyod dag gis rgya gar du lan gsum phyin nas/ bla ma brgya lnga bcu btsal rtsa ba'i bla ma lnga'am bzhi yod pas khyod grub thob tu gyur nas/ snang ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa yin zer bas/ brag 'di la phar thal tshur thal 'ga' res gyis la/ nam mkha' 'di la dkyil dkrung gyis la 'dug dang zer ba la/ brag de la thal byung su phyin te/ nam mkha' la dkyil dkrung bcas nas gcig dang du mar snang ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'ga' re bstan pas/ rong po dang grwa pa thams cad shin tu dad de/ de lta bu'i yon tan 'di gang bsgoms pa las byung ba lags zer ba la/ chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu la/ /sgyu ma lta bur nyams blangs pas/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /snang yang bden med chos rnams la/ /byis pas bden par bzung bas 'khrul/ /med bzhin snang ba e ma ho/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i chos bshad pas thams cad dad de/ zla ba bcu gcig na rong pos yi dam gyi zhal mthong ste/ snang ba bden med du rtogs so/ /dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gcig gi tho rangs ḍa ki ma mang po byung nas yar gyi bcu dang mar gyi bcu/ yar gyi bcu bzhi dang mar gyi bcu bzhi la tshogs brgya rtsa gcig gyis shig

khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum lte ba gsang gnas dang lngar/ rgyud sde lnga'i tshogs rnams dbyer med du gyur nas/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro gsungs nas de ltar tshogs brgya rtsa lan bzhi byas pas rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad zhal mngon sum du mthong rang dang dbyer med du gyur te/ de nas spyi zla 'bring po'i tshes bdun gyi nam 'jing yol tsa na/ ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma kun tu bzang mo byon nas/ tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri phrag brgyad/ /slob ma'i mthar thug lnga dang gcig /tshe'i mthar thug brgya dang lnga bcu'o/ /zhing khams mthar thug bde ba can/ /zhes gsungs pas dang / des sad byed byas nas tshogs pa che dus su khri tsho brgyad dang / sngar bu lnga la phyis bu gcig dang / lo brgya dang lnga bcu thub pa dang / tshe'i dus byas nas bde ba can du 'gro ba dang / sems can gyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal la sogs pa ji lta bzhin du shes pa byung nas/ slob ma rnams la en re bshad pas/ ḍa ki ma su ka ma si ti byon nas/ snyigs ma'i sems can log lta can/ /rgyal bas kyang ni ma thul zhing / /mkhyen pa'i spyan la bdud 'dzin pas/ /yon tan sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /zhes lan gsum gsungs pas/ rang rgyud pa'i tshul gyis rang gi yon tan thams cad stun tshad kyis sbas so/ /de nas tshogs pa che dus su khams pa'i mi tshang rnams 'bul ba byed pa la ma 'cham pas/ dus gcig la khri brgya rtsa brgyad brtsigs nas/ khri re la mi tshang re'i 'bul ba 'gran nas byas so/ /de'i dus su rin chen rdo rjes gzim g.yog byas pas/ tha mal rang rgyud du bzung nas log lta en re byed kyin 'dug nas yi ge brgya pa dang dag byed stong ra zhag bdun bsgoms nas/ gzim chung du byung pa dang / nga cir mthong byas pas/ bla ma ber thul gsol mthong zer/ da cir mthong byas pas/ phyag 'tshal nas dgyes rdor mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum du mthong zer/

yang gnas lngar rgyud sde lnga bkod pas kyang der mthong 'dug nas/ phyir song byas nas phyir phyin pa dang / chos khri brgya rtsa brgyad kyi steng na/ nga'i lus brgya rtsa brgyad du sprul bas/ de rnams chos sna tshogs bshad par mthong ba dang / nang du 'ongs nas bltas pa dang / yang dgyes rdor du mthong nas/ dus da nas bzung nas tha mal du skad cig kyang ma lta ang byas pas/ rin chen rdo rje na re/ sku lus sprul pa'i lha dgu las/ gnas lnga rgyud sde'i lnga'i lha/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyi chos khri la/ /lta nas mi ngoms sku lus te/ /mtha' bral chen po'i chos sgra sgrog /sna tshogs sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs sprul pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas khyed la bstod/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams/ /yang dag lam la 'dzud du gsol/ zhes khos bstod do/ /de nas log lta skad cig kyang ma skyes par/ ci gsung nyan pa'i nye gnas su gyur to/ /de nas yang byams pa'i chos lnga dang gsang ba spyi rgyud pa'i 'tsho ba 'dren pa la dbus gtsang khams gsum gyis grwa pa rnams ma 'cham par/ dam sel du 'gro bar byung ba dang / rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha'i tshogs rnams byung nas/ thar med gnas su skye ba dang / thar pa'i srog gcod byed pa ni/ /mi mthun dag las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dam tshig smos ci dgos/ /mthun pa'i bka' thub dag las ni/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas rnyed mi dka'/ /de phyir 'dir tshogs rnyed mi dka'/ /de phyir 'dir tshogs lha rnams kyis/ /chos gsung tshe na bsnyen bskur bya/ /ta la bdun srid cig kyang rung / /mkha' la chos char dbab tu gsol/ /chos kyi sgron chen spar du gsol/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng du gsol/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ /zla ba bdun du mi zas mi za bar dam bcas nas/ nam mkha' la shing rta la gcig gi tshad tsam du/ zla ba bdun gyi bar la byams pa'i chos lnga dang /

gsang ba spyi rgyud tshar ba byas pas/ dbu ma'i lta ba khong du chud pa mang po byung ba dang / lha rnams kyis mgrin gcig du 'di skad brjod par gyur to/ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur to/ /lha rnams tshim par gyur to/ /mi rnams grol bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba chen po byas par gyur to/ /a la la zhes lan gsum du brjod cing / me tog gi char chen po phab nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /yang gnas skyes khar gyi rdzong la sgom tsa na/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa nam mkha' khengs pa tsam gyis sku shin tu che ba mthong nas/ drag po gsum 'dul gyi gdams pa gsungs/ dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi tho rangs sangs rgyas 'od dpag med byon nas bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi bkod pa rnams bstan nas/ khyod ni skye ba tha ma te/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas/ /mngon par byang chub 'khor lo bskor/ /gang gis khyod kyi rjes slob cing / /'od dpag mtshan tsam thos pas kyang / /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /rdzu 'phrul chen pos skye bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyi rgyud 'dzin rnam pa gsum/ /mngon dga' dang ni bde ba can/ /dag pa'i zhing nas zhing du 'gro/ /der ni mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /zhes la sogs pa'i lung bstan pa mang po mdzad do/ /de nas tshogs pa khri tsho brgyad 'dus pa'i dus su/ bshad grwa chen mo ba phrag dog skyes nas/ yang na zhong zhong pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ yang na grwa pa nyung dus su bla ma dgrong la grwa pa 'di med par bya'o zhes gros byas pas/ grwa pa gzhon pa rnams chos zhus nas slob ma byas pa rang 'thad zer ba la/ rgad po gsum gros 'cham ste/ gcig gis chos zhu na thams cad kyis chos zhus nas/ grwa pa 'di 'jigs pas/ de bas grwa pa nyung dus su dmag byed zer ro/ /de nas bya byung nas/ bla ma la nye gnas rin chen rdo rjes/

khong dmag byed par 'dug pas/ yang na phar la rgyab la grwa pa chen mo ba med par bya/ yang na bros pa rang 'thad zer ba la/ ngas chos byas pas gnod 'tshe'i dmag mi byed/ nga rang gi gnas dgon 'di rnams gsar du btab pas 'bros don med byas nas ma nyan pa dang / ston kha grwa pa nyung dus su dmag stong tsho lnga nam langs ma thog byung bas/ rin chen rdo rje na re kha ning nas dmag sog pa'am 'bros dgos byas pas ma gsan/ da dmag gis 'khor nas 'dug pas ci tsug byed zer ba la/ ting nge 'dzin nam sprul pa'i dmag gis dmag stong tsho lnga po de ri lung med par ded nas/ rmas pa dang shi ba med par g.yul ngo rgyal bar byas pas/ khong rnams dad de thams cad slob mar gyur nas rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung nas/ ci yod thams cad phul lo/ /yang mu ge chen po cig byung ba'i dus su/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ lung bstan byung nas/ snga dro thang chen po la nas btab pas phyi dro nas smin nas zad mi shes pa'i ston thog byung ste/ mu ge las thar bar byas so/ /yang stag gi lo'i ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma bco lnga la dbang bskur bas/ dus de nas bzung nas de nas zhal mthong mang du byung ngo / /dge bshes gha pa chos rgyal gyis 'bul ba chen po byas nas/ byams pa'i chos lnga dang / 'bum tig dang / le'u brgyad ma nas yi ge gcig ma yan chad mkhas par bslabs nas sgom lo byas pa yin ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba thag ma chod/ da bod rgad po rnams la zhus ma zhus mi 'dug pas/ bla mas rnal lam bzung nas yum chen mo la lta ba rnam dag zhus nas nga la gnang bar zhu/ nga tshe thung rigs yin pas/ tshe dpag med la tshe sgrub gcig zhu/ snying rje 'di skye dka' bar byung bas/ thugs rje chen po la snying rje rtsol med du skye ba gcig zhu/ rnam sras bsgrubs kyang ma 'khol bas/

phyag na rdo rje la rgyud gdams pa'i gnad cig zhu/ rje btsun ma la lo gsum sgrub pa byas kyang dbang gi las gcig kyang ma 'grub pas/ u rgyan du rje btsun ma la snang srid g.yo 'gul gyi gnad cig zhu zer nas/ bdag gis rmi lam bzung nas/ 'og min du phyin nas yum chen mo la sras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor nas thams cad kyang chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can sha stag tu bzhugs kyin 'dug pa la mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa phul nas chos zhus pas/ mthar thug skye med rnam gsum gyi gdams pa gnang ngo / /yang bde ba can du phyin pas mgon po 'od dpag med de nyid byang chub kyi shing gi steng na spyan ras gzigs dang / rta mgrin dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor nas/ brda'i sgo nas chos ston zhing 'dug pa la/ bdag gis gser dngul gyi me tog gi char chen po phab lus kyi lha'i bu dang bu mos/ rol mo sna tshogs thogs pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas phul te/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i sems can tshe thung ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol zhes zhus pa dang / sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang byang chub kyi shing gnyis ka las chos kyi sgra byung ste/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i tshe bsgrub gsungs so/ /de nas yang po ta lar phyin nas/ thugs rje chen po gnod sbyin rnams la byams pa'i chos gsung yin 'dug pa dang mjal nas gtso 'khor gsum las 'od zer gsum byung nas/ bdag gi gnas gsum du zug ste/ 'od zer de dag la chos kyi sgra chen po byung ste/ de yang 'di skad do/ /chos rnams rang bzhin skye med las/ /'gags med snying rje ma shar na/ /'gro drug sems can ma rgan rnams/ /smin zhing grol bar mi nus pas/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du/ /ma'i drin dang sdug bsngal rnams/ /ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung / /tshad med snying rje chen po bskyed/

/byams pa'i gangs ri chen po las/ /snying rje'i chu rgyun bsil ba yis/ /nyon mongs me dpung zhi bar mdzod/ /nga ni snying rje chen po'i sku/ /zhes pa la sogs pa snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin gsungs so/ /yang lcang lo can du phyin te gsang ba'i bdag pos gnod sbyin shing rta'i rgyud dang / gnod sbyin srog gi snying po dang / gnod sbyin yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs rnams gsungs so/ /yang tshes bcu'i srod la mchod pa phul nas/ tho rangs u rgyan du phyin nas rje btsun ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhus pa dang / ḍa ki ma seng ge'i gdong pa can ḍa ki sde bzhis bskor nas 'di skad gsung / rdo rje mkha' 'gros bar chad bsrung / /rin chen mkha' 'gros mi nor bsgrub/ /padma mkha' 'gros bud med bsdus/ /'phrin las mkha' 'gros las kun bsgrub/ /'dod sred chags pa'i dbang song bas/ /bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i dbang du 'gro/ /phyi rol mi 'du ya ga 'byung / /ḍa ki rang gi sems su shes/ /sems kyi de nyid shes pa dang / /sems nyid mi rtog rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros bar chad bsrung / /chog shes dgos med rin chen bzhin/ /rin chen ḍa ki dgos 'dod bsgrub/ /chags bral mi rtog pad mas te/ /padma ḍa ki mu tra bsdus/ /skye 'gag med pas skar ma ste/ /las kyi ḍa ki 'phrin las bsgrub/ /de ltar ma shes rnal 'byor pas/ /bskal par bsgrubs kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de phyir mkha' 'gro rang sems su shes pa gnad kyi mchog yin no/ /ces sogs 'char ba gsum dang / 'du ba rnam gsum gyi gdams ngag gsungs so/ /de nas dge bshes gha pas tshogs mchod brgya rtsa byas te/ gdams pa rnams bshad nas nyams len byas pas/ mthar thug skye med kyi don rtogs tshe dpag med kyi zhal mthong / snying rje phyogs med du shar/ rnam sras bran du nyan/ ḍa kis 'phrin las ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub pa byung ngo /

/de nas yang 'ga' sa na re/ bla ma chen po lags/ rmi lam du sangs rgyas la chos zhus pa dang / dngos su zhus pa la khyad yod dam med zer ba la/ sangs rgyas sku dang zhing khams dang / /'khor dang chos la sogs pa rnams/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /dngos dang rmi lam tha dad med/ /ces byas pas/ chos rgyal shin tu mos par gyur to/ /yang dpon khyung po na re/ shab kyi ba ra nag po 'di dang / gnyan thang lha dang / jo bo ban chen dang gsum po 'di/ nged mi rta gnyis la gnod pa skyel ba byung bas rnal lam bzung la 'du bar zhu zer ba la/ ngas rdo rje 'jigs byed du byas nas nyin par thog bcu gsum phab/ mtshan mo rmi lam bzung nas ma hes rdung stangs byed kyin/ pheṃ gi sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pas 'ba' ra nag po na re/ bla ma chen po de ltar mi mdzad par zhu/ nga'i 'khor thams cad thog gi bsad ma he'i ras gnas khang thams cad bshig /nga khrag bskyugs nas 'chi bar yod pas/ dpon khyung po'i rta khyer ba la rta brgya yi yus byed zer ba la/ khyed rang srog sngags phul/ sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed pa'i dge bsnyen gyis shig de ma yin na dus 'dir brlag par bya'o byas pas/ 'ba' ra nag pos srog sngags phul lo/ /dge bsnyen byas nas rta brgya dang / phyugs mang po'i yus byas te 'phrin las sar tshud do/ /gnyan thang lha'i gangs la dngos su thog brgya dus gcig la phab pas gangs thams cad nyil/ mtsho rdol bas/ kho dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga'i gzugs su byas nas/ thang lhar gdan drangs nas rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas srog sngags phul lo/ /yar lha sham po dang / ma dros pa zhong zhong du byung nas rnam 'joms kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ srog sngags phul nas longs spyod sgrub pa'i yon bdag tu khas blangs so/ /yang gshin rje dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor du sprul nas/ jo bo ban tsan dang klu srin du bcas pa thams cad btul bas gan chad ma gtogs pa/

sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed par dam bcas nas khong rang gi sgrub thabs dang mchod thabs phul lo/ /de yang mi bas lha 'dre tshor ngas che bar 'dug pas/ mi la gnod pa byed pa'i 'dre la mi 'di la gnod pa ma byed par rgyug cig mi 'gro na ngas 'dul lo byas nas 'phrin btang ba tsam gyis 'gro bar byung ngo / /lar rmi lam du rdo rje 'jigs byed du byas nas lha 'dre btul ba 'di ka sob che bar byung ngo / /de yang sos ka me tog brgyas pa'i dus su tshogs pa'i mthar thug dang / slob ma'i mthar thug dang / tshe mthar thug dang 'dzom pa'i dus su/ ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bdun la/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi bla ma rnams byon nas/ zhag bdun du dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur/ ye shes sems dpa' dngos su stim nas/ khyung po rnal 'byor 'di na gdul bya mi che bar 'dug pas/ rgya gar lho phyogs su gshegs 'tshal/ de na gdul bya dpag tu med pa yod do gsungs so/ /yang zla ba de'i tshes bcu gsum la/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med byon nas zhag bdun du dbang bskur/ ye shes sems dpa' bstim nas/ 'di na gdul bya mi che bar 'dug pas/ bde ba can du gshegs 'tshal/ da res byon na lus 'di ma spangs par 'ja' lus su sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro gsungs pa la/ ngas chos rnams phangs sems byas nas rdzogs par ma byin pas/ da slob rnams bsags nas chos rnams rdzogs par ster dgos pa yod byas nas zhus pas/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang bla ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ da res byon na lus 'di ma spangs par 'ja' lus su sangs rgyas pa yin te/ da rnam smin gyi lus 'di bzhag nas bde ba can du sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /sku lus 'di me la ma sbyangs na zhong zhong 'di rdo rje gdan gnyis par 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi chos brgyud rnams kyang chu bo'i rgyun lta bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes lan gsum gsungs nas mi gnang bar gyur to/

/de nas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi slob ma rnying pa rnams la yi ge brdzangs te/ ston zla ra ba la grwa pa gsar rnying thams cad 'dus te/ chos kyi 'khor lo lo gsum du bskor nas/ chos thams cad ma lus par tshar bar byas so/ /de la bdag khyung po rnal 'byor gyis rgya gar du lan gsum phyin nas/ bla ma brgya lnga bcu gser dang mos gus kyis mnyes par byas nas/ dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ gdams ngag khyad par gyi zhal gdams dang bcas pa rnams zhus so/ /de las kyang khyad par gyi bla ma bcu gsum dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi dang / 'gran gyi do med ye shes kyi ḍa ki ma zhal gnyis la dbang byin brlabs/ rgyud sgrub thabs/ las tshogs lag len dang bcas pa/ gdams ngag chig rgyud bka' rgya dang bcas pa rnams zhus/ slob ma rnams tshim par byas pa yin no/ /de yang spyir nga'i gdams ngag 'di gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas/ 'go byin nas 'gos phan thogs/ bar byin na bar gyis phan thogs/ gsham byin na gsham gyis phan thogs pa yin yang lhag ma bzhag par ma lus byin pa yin pas/ the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed par brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su longs zhig bla ma sangs rgyas dngos la zhus pa/ ḍa ki dngos su 'du ba/ yon tan dngos su 'byung ba/ rgyud pa'i bka' babs dang ldan pa/ mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ gdams ngag gi nus pa dang ldan pa 'di nyams su long zhig dbang po rab rnam smin/ 'bring bag chags/ tha ma yang bar dor sangs mi rgya ba mi srid pa yin no/ /bdag gi bka' babs dang gdams ngag gi gnad 'di lta bu rgya bod gang na yang med par thag chod pa yin no/ /de la bla ma dang yi dam rnams kyis lung bstan pa'i zhong zhong gi gnas 'dir grwa pa dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sa gzhi la/ dri med shes rab kyi sdong po 'jam dpal dang / 'jigs byed la mnga' brnyes pa'i rme'u ston pa skyes/ phan sems kyi yal ga byams pa la chos nyan pa'i g.yor po rgya mo che/

tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po'i yal 'dab spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med pa'i dngul ston rin dbang / byams pa phyogs med shar ba'i me tog bde mchog dang / mgon po'i bdag nyid las bstod dkon mchog 'khar dang / sgyu lus rmi lam gyi 'bras bu smin pa'i rin chen brtson 'grus/ lha sku 'od gsal dbyer med kyi snying po mngon du gyur zhing / ḍa ki dngos su 'du ba'i rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng ngo sngags bu lnga dang / phyis bu gcig dang drug po 'di bla ma dang yi dam rnams kyi lung bstan thob pa/ yi dam dpag tu med par chos zhu ba/ chos nyid don ji lta ba bzhin du thugs su chud pa yin pas/ mched grogs dang slob ma rnams kyis phrag dog log lta ma byed par nga dang khyad med du blta bar bya'o/ /de nas tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri tsho brgyad la lo mang po dpag tu med pa bstan/ slob ma'i mthar thug drug la ni chos ma lus par tshar/ tshe'i mthar thug brgya dang lnga bcu la thug nas/ rgya gar gyi bla ma rdo rje mched gsum dang / phyi rol pa'i slob dpon 'jigs med rdo rje la zhus pa'i ngan sngags mang po yod pa rnams rgyal khams su mched na 'jig rten phung gis dogs nas phal cher rdza la sbas te tshogs mchod brgya rtsa dang / spong dag byas pa'i snga dro/ rgyal po bzhi dang klu ma dros pa dang / dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa la sogs pa'i mi ma yin mang po 'dus te/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i longs spyod chen po phul nas/ mya ngan 'das par ma dgongs par/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can rnams/ /yang dag lam la bzhugs su gsol/ /ji srid bzhugs kyi bar du yang / /cir dgos longs spyod nged kyis bsgrub/ /ces zer ba la/ bdag gis 'di skad ces smras te/ /bla ma yi dam lung bstan pa'i/ /mthar thug gsum gyi dus la bab/ /da ni zhing khams mthar thug pa'i/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gro /dag pa'i longs spyod dpag tu med/

/'jigs rten gser dngul dgos pa med/ /khyed rnams nga la dad gyur na/ /bde ba can du gsol ba thob/ zhing der skye ba the tshom med/ /rdul cig steng na rdul rnyed zhing / /bsam gyis mi khyab rdzogs par snang / /zhing dang ston pa 'khor dang chos/ /dpag tu med pas 'od dpag zhing / /rnam par dag pas bde ba can/ /de phyir the tshom ma byed par/ /zhing der skye ba smon lam thob/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i chos bshad nas/ nga ni nges par bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /byas pas/ der tshogs pa'i ḍā ki dang / lha 'dre thams cad kyis gdung pa'i smre sngags 'don zhing / me tog gi char chen po phab nas mi snang bar gyur ro/ /de nas tshes bcu bzhi la bla ma tshogs su byon nas/ de ring ni nga yi chos bshad pa'i tha ma yin pas/ chos kyi skabs gang du ma bde ba dang drir rgyu yod pa rnams dris shig da res ni the tshom gcod pa'i dus la bab bo gsungs pa dang / thams cad kyis cho nge chen po btab pas/ bla mas nam mkha' la sku lus kyi bkod pa mang po ston cing / kye ma 'dus byas mi rtag te/ /nam mkha'i sprin bzhin 'dus shing 'gyes/ /bden med sgyu ma'i chos rnams la/ /bden par bzung bas slus pa yin/ /nga'i lus 'di rgyal ba'i sku/ /skye 'chi can du ma blta zhig /nga'i ngag ni rgyal ba'i gsungs/ /brjod bral skye med rang sgra sgrog /nga'i sems ni rgyal ba'i thugs/ /rtog bral mkhyen pa'i ye shes ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' dang 'od dang rol mo'i sgras gang zhing me tog gi char chen po bab par gyur to/ /de nas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nas yar byon ste/ gzim khang du gdan la bzhugs nas/ rin chen brtson 'grus me tog 'thus la shog /bu chen rnams kyang khyod kyis bos shig gsung ngo / de nas me tog dmar po mang po 'thus bla ma la phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ḍa ki ma ni gu ma'i thugs dam rje btsun ma 'di dang bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i rten gtso 'di dang /

gshin rje gshed dang / dgyes rdor gyi rdos sku 'di dang / bla ma a ta ya na badzra gyi thugs dam 'di dang / rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa'i rten 'di rnams 'dir phul zhig zer tsa nas rten de rnams nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la bla mas phyag mdzad/ yang mchod pa phul zhig gsungs tsa na/ ḍa ki ma ni gu ma dang / su ka ma hā si ti la sogs pa bla ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la sogs pa'i yi dam rnams byon pas gsol ba thob cig gsungs/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ rin chen brtson 'grus sgyu lus rmi lam la sogs pa'i chos 'di rnams nyams su len tsa na/ rmi lam mi 'tshams pa dang / ḍa ki ma'i gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur nas/ ltas dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa 'ong pas de la 'jigs mi dgos/ lar dus dang rnam pa thams cad du nga rang gis byin gyi rlob pa gcig gsung ngo / de nang bu chen rnams 'dus pa dang / dgyes rdor ba rnams la dgyes rdor du bsgoms shig gsungs tsa na/ bla ma nyid dgyes rdor mtshon cha can dang / sprul pa'i lha dgur bzhugs nas chos gsungs/ de bzhin du bde mchog dang / gsang 'dus dang / ma hā mā yā dang / 'jigs byed dang / thugs rje chen po dang / sgrol ma dang / mi g.yo ba la sogs par zhus nas chos gsungs/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha bzhi'i dbu'i steng du bkod nas 'di bzhin du nyams su longs shig gsung ngo / /de nas yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga la rgya gar gyi bla ma rnams kyis dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur ba'i dus su ye shes sems dpa' dngos su stim pa yin pas/ ye shes sems dpa' mi gshegs par dpur sbyong du mi btub ste/ de la nga lhag pa nam yang med de/ nga dang mnyam pa yang med pas nga'i pur ma sbyang bar/ rin po che gser dngul dang zangs lcags kyi ga'u nang du nga'i dpur zhugs la mchod pa phul/ de ltar byas na zhong zhong gi gnas 'di rdo rje gdan gnyis pa lta bu la/ nga'i chos brgyud 'di chu bo'i gzhung lta bu gcig 'ong bar 'dug ste/

khyed rnams kyis gros nyes gcig mi byed dam gsungs so/ /da 'di nas bla ma zhing khams gang du gshegs/ gsol gang du 'debs zhus pas/ nga 'di nas bde ba can du sangs rgya bas gsol ba der thob/ the tshom yid gnyis ma byed ang lan gsum gsungs so/ /de nas 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma sgom pa rnams 'di bzhin du nyams su long zhig gsungs tsa na dbu thod lag mthil tsam gcig nam mkha' la 'phar te/ sgra dang 'od dang 'ja' tshon du gyur nas gshegs so/ /de nas zangs lcags dang gser dngul gyi ga'u brdungs nas der dpur zhugs pa'i grabs byas tsa na/ khams pa'i grwa pa mang la dbang che bas khong rnams na re/ bla ma'i dpur mi sbyangs na/ dpur khams su gdan 'dren pa yin/ dngul gyi gdung khang byas nas bzhugs pas chog zer ba la/ mi drag byas kyang ma nyan par dpur sbyangs/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang / lha bzhi la sogs pa'i sku dang / gdung dang ring bsrel dang / dung g.yas 'khyil la sogs pa'i rten mang po byon no/ /'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char chen po/ nam mkha' thams cad khengs pa'i zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar byung ngo / /de'i rjes la sku 'bum bzhengs pas/ me tog gi char rgyun du 'bab pa dang / mkha' 'gro dang / lha klus mchod pa phul nas/ 'bum pa'i phyogs bzhi nas/ mar me'i 'od lta bu rgyun du byung ste/ lha mi thams cad kyis mchod pa'i rten du gyur to/ /de la rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng dang / bla ma rme'u ston pa dang / bla ma rmog cog pa dang / nye gnas rin chen rdo rje dang bzhi la rnam thar du gsungs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ //bla ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /chu thigs tsam zhig yi ger bkod/ /dge ba de yis sems can rnams/ /bla med byang chub 'thob par shog /grub thob chen po khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i rnam par thar pa cung zad yi ger bkod pa 'di/ yongs su rdzogs pa'o/

/'di bris dge ba bsod nams chen po des/ /drin can bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs nas/ /drin can rnams kyis thugs rjes 'dzin pa dang / /pha mas gtso byas 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /sgyu ma'i don rtogs myur du sangs rgyas shog/ //maṅga laṃ bha wantu// //shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 38 khyung po rnal 'byor/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i rnam thar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 37
